title: The Nikola Truck That Rolled Downhill: Trevor Milton's Fraud Case
summary:
How was Nikola founder Trevor Milton convicted of fraud? The Nikola One truck in the famous "in motion" video was not driving — according to the SEC, it was towed up an incline and filmed rolling down. In 2022 a Manhattan jury convicted Milton of securities fraud and wire fraud; he was sentenced to four years, stayed free on bail pending appeal, and in March 2025 received a full and unconditional presidential pardon.
United States v. Trevor Milton, from the court record: the 2016 unveiling, the "Behold, the Nikola One in motion" video, the Badger and hydrogen claims, the SPAC and Milton's $7.3 billion paper peak, the Hindenburg report, the 2022 verdict, the sentencing, the $660.8 million restitution request — and the pardon 13 days later.
docs_note: Documents shown are U.S. Department of Justice filings, U.S. district court records, SEC court filings and the executive grant of clemency (public domain). SEC complaint statements are allegations. The sentencing transcript and trial exhibits are quoted, not shown. Private individuals are not named.
